Subject: Level-change briefing — Priya N. (CONFIDENTIAL): timeline & review plan

Team,

Attached is the initial level-change write-up and compensation rationale for Priya Natarajan. This is confidential while we assemble the committee packet — please do not forward outside the thread. Key asks:

- Read the attached write-up and comp sheet by EOD Monday (7/6).
- Add any redlines/edits to the PDF (comments are fine) or send a tracked-change doc.
- Call out any conflicts of interest (direct reports, dotted-line reviewers, handoffs) in a one-line reply.
- Confirm whether we should seek a small, targeted calibration with Eng Leadership before committee.

Timeline: I need a finalized packet to submit to People Ops for sanitization by 7/14 so the committee can review the week of 7/20. Please treat this as time-sensitive. If you have blocking calibration feedback, flag it now.

Attachments: Priya_Natarajan_level-change_writeup_draft.pdf, comp_rationale_priya.xlsx

Summary (quick): Priya is being considered for a level change from L3 -> L4. She has led three cross-team launches in the last 12 months, drove the latency initiative that hit SLA targets, and is coaching two ICs. Manager write-up articulates scope expansion and leadership behaviors.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks for pulling this together. A few quick notes from my read-through:

1) I agree with the scope examples, but the write-up could be strengthened with two concise impact bullets that tie outcomes to metrics (example: "reduced tail latency by 22% for inference under load, improving p95 from 480ms -> 375ms").
2) Compensation sheet looks reasonable; recommend a modest midpoint push to reflect market — I'll redline comp_rationale_priya.xlsx with suggested ranges.
3) No conflicts from my side.
4) I support a brief calibration with Eng Leadership (15–20m) to ensure consistent expectation-setting before committee — can attend if scheduled next week.

I've attached a lightly annotated PDF with marginal comments: Priya_Natarajan_level-change_writeup_draft.pdf (v2).

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering (Infra)

Thanks for the heads-up and for keeping this thread tight. A few process items from People Ops:

- Committee submission: upload the finalized PDF(s) to the private Drive folder (link below) and tag me so I can run the pre-check checklist. I will scrub manager-identifying comments where required.
- DocuSign flow: once leadership approves, we will route the comp approval via DocuSign (link included in metadata).
- Committee windows: tentative committee week is 7/20–7/24. We need finalized packet in Drive by 7/14 COB.
- Notification timing: Do you want People Ops to prepare a pre-decision schedule for the candidate (i.e., tentative effective date + communication draft) or wait until after committee? If you want an early schedule, I recommend we share only the tentative effective date without specifics.

Drive for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPRIVATEDRIVEID
